name: sarkaritaiyaari
description: Workspace root. Holds the shared package and the student web app; mobile/ and admin/ remain independent npm projects (see packages/core/README.md).

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @sarkaritaiyaari/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @sarkaritaiyaari/web
scripts.qa:generate: node scripts/qa/generate-test-data.js && node scripts/qa/generate-suites.js && node scripts/qa/generate-reports.js

devDependenciesComment: js-yaml is required by scripts/qa/*.js. Those scripts predate this file, so until now the dependency was undeclared and they only ran where it happened to be installed globally.
